title: Listening: Notes and Distractors
ringkas: Mengikuti perubahan jawaban, kata kunci, dan jebakan koreksi

lesson.text: Rekaman IELTS Listening sering memuat **pengecoh (distractors)**: pembicara menyebut satu informasi, lalu **mengoreksinya**. Jawaban yang benar biasanya adalah informasi **terakhir**. Latihan di sini memakai suara; dengarkan dengan teliti, lalu jawab.

lesson.title: 1. Isyarat koreksi
table: [[It's on Monday. Actually, it's on Tuesday.]]
[[Room twelve. Sorry, I mean room fourteen.]]

lesson.title: 2. Langkah menjawab
table: Baca soal, garis bawahi kata kunci, tebak jenis jawaban (angka, nama, tempat)
Ikuti urutan soal; catat; waspada isyarat koreksi
Pindahkan jawaban; cek ejaan dan batas kata

lesson.title: Pengecoh mengikuti pola
lesson.text: Penutur sering menyebut dua pilihan lalu memilih satu. Tulislah jawaban **setelah** kamu yakin tidak ada koreksi lagi, bukan saat kata pertama muncul.

lesson.title: Ejaan dan format
lesson.text: Jawaban dengan ejaan salah dianggap salah. Perhatikan juga huruf besar untuk nama, dan angka vs kata sesuai perintah.

practice.say: The meeting is on Monday. Actually, it has been moved to Tuesday.
Please go to room twelve. Sorry, I mean room fourteen.
practice.exp: 'Sorry, I mean' = koreksi menjadi empat belas.

practice.say: The train leaves at six. No, wait, it leaves at seven.
The event is not in the library, but in the main hall.
I'll have coffee. On second thought, I'll have tea.
The fee is forty dollars. Actually, there is a discount, so it is thirty.
Our guide is Mr. Brown. Sorry, his name is Mr. Brand.

practice.q: Dengarkan. Hari apa kunjungan ke museum?
practice.say: We'll visit the museum on Wednesday, not Thursday.
There are fifteen people. Wait, two more joined, so seventeen.
First we'll go hiking. Actually, the weather is bad, so we'll start with a museum visit.
The deadline is the fifth of June. No, sorry, the fifteenth.
It was a blue car. Hmm, actually, it was dark green.
Take bus number twenty. Sorry, I mean number twelve.

practice.q: Dengarkan. Ke mana mereka akan pergi?
practice.say: We could go to the beach. But it's cold, so let's go to the cinema.
Adult tickets are twelve pounds. Children pay half price.

practice.q: Jawaban yang benar biasanya adalah informasi...

options: informasi yang mirip tetapi bukan jawaban

practice.exp: By the way hanya mengganti topik.

practice.q: Room twelve. Sorry, I ___ room fourteen.

practice.id: Isyarat koreksi: 'On second ___ , I will have tea.'
practice.q: On second ___, I will have tea.

quiz.say: The class begins on Thursday. Actually, it begins on Friday.
Your seat is number sixty. Sorry, I mean number sixteen.
Let's meet at the cafe. No, wait, at the station.
I'll take juice. Actually, a glass of water, please.
The book is nineteen dollars. Oh, sorry, it's ninety.
The exam is on the fourth of May. Wait, the fourteenth.
My brother will pick you up. No, my sister will do it.
We could take a taxi. But it's expensive, so we'll take the bus.

quiz.q: "Not the library, but the hall." Jawabannya...
quiz.exp: not ... but. Jawaban yang tepat: **the hall**.
